title: Colour Hunt
summary: Songbird asks V to find five colours around Pacifica and describe what each one feels like.

start.bringUp: Songbird says Dogtown is grey and asks V to find five colours and say what each one feels like.

spot.name: the plaza by the Pacifica stadium

colour-1.name: a painted mural on a Pacifica wall

colour-4.name: a green rag on a fence

colour-5.name: a magenta scrap of cloth on a rail

SBH4.ask.01.text: What does this one feel like?

g1.asks: What does this one feel like?
g1.know: The colours you have found so far.
g1.secret: Magenta was the first colour she ever chose.
g1.wants: You to say one honest thing.

variations.know: It is night, and the colours are neon signs now.
Only three colours are on the list tonight.

variations.wants: V picks the colours, and she guesses them from the descriptions.

stages.label: Songbird sends V to find five colours
stages.know: V is in Pacifica looking for five colours. You picked the list, and the fifth colour is the one you chose first.
stages.wants: V to find the colours, describe them, and say one honest thing about the last one.

honest.memory: You found five colours around Pacifica for Songbird and told her one true thing about the magenta scrap.

flattered.memory: You found five colours around Pacifica for Songbird and said something kind about the last one, without meaning it much.

left.memory: You found a couple of colours around Pacifica for Songbird and went home before the list was done.

stood-up.memory: You never went looking for the five colours in Pacifica, and Songbird sent nothing to the plaza.
